intent.job_to_be_done: Audit project and global .agents/skills and .claude/skills layouts: verify that .agents/skills holds the real source and .claude/skills mirrors it through a parent or per-skill symlink. Report orphan directories, missing links, duplicated directories, broken links, and wrong targets with reviewable fix commands. Audit only; never modify the audited directories.
target_users: anyone debugging a skill that will not load
outputs: suggested fix commands for human review
exclusions: automatically moving, deleting, or overwriting files
